registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register. Bit 0 ENABLE is stored. Bit 1 SAMPLE_START is a write-pulse that reads back as 0. Bit 2 IRQ_ENABLE is stored. Bit 3 ALERT_CLEAR is a write-pulse that clears alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending and reads back as 0. Reserved bits [15:4] read as 0 and ignore writes.

fields.name: SAMPLE_START
fields.description: Write 1 requests one conversion and generates a one-cycle sample_req pulse. Readback is always 0.

fields.name: ALERT_CLEAR
fields.description: Write 1 clears alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending. Readback is always 0.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status register. Bit 0 sample_done is sticky after any completed adc_valid sample until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1. Bit 1 alert_pending mirrors latched alert_status until ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 is written. Bit 2 adc_valid_seen is sticky after the first adc_valid sample until reset. Bit 3 busy is high while a requested sample is pending. Reserved bits [15:4] read as 0.

fields.name: sample_done
fields.description: Sticky after any completed adc_valid sample until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1.

fields.name: alert_pending
fields.description: Mirrors latched alert_status until cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0.

fields.name: adc_valid_seen
fields.description: Sticky after the first adc_valid sample until reset.

fields.name: busy
fields.description: High while a requested sample is pending.

registers.name: THRESHOLD
registers.description: Temperature threshold register. threshold_code is bits [11:0]. Upper bits [15:12] read as 0.

registers.name: LATEST_TEMP
registers.description: Latest filtered temperature code. latest_temp/temp_code are bits [11:0]. Upper bits [15:12] read as 0.

registers.name: SAMPLE_COUNT
registers.description: Completed sample count. This register is not cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky interrupt status register. Bit 0 alert. Bit 1 sample_done. Reserved bits [15:2] read as 0.

registers.name: IRQ_CLEAR
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear register. Bit 0 clears IRQ_STATUS.alert and alert_status. Bit 1 clears IRQ_STATUS.sample_done and STATUS.sample_done. Reserved bits are ignored. Writing this register does not modify LATEST_TEMP, THRESHOLD, or SAMPLE_COUNT.

sources.name: alert
sources.description: Asserted when CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE is set and IRQ_STATUS.alert is latched.

sources.name: sample_done
sources.description: Asserted through sticky IRQ_STATUS.sample_done; observed in alert_irq when CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE is set.

interrupts.behavior: alert_irq asserts when CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE is set and any IRQ_STATUS bit is latched.

init_sequence: Write THRESHOLD[11:0] with the desired threshold code.
Optionally clear any stale sticky state by writing IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 and bit 1 as needed.
Write CONTROL.IRQ_ENABLE=1 to allow alert_irq assertion.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS.sample_done or IRQ_STATUS.sample_done to detect completed samples.
Read LATEST_TEMP to obtain the latest filtered temperature code.
Read SAMPLE_COUNT to track completed conversions.
Read STATUS.alert_pending or IRQ_STATUS.alert to observe threshold violations.
irq_sequence: On alert_irq, read IRQ_STATUS to determine the source bits.
If alert is set, handle the threshold violation and write IRQ_CLEAR bit 0 to clear alert_status and IRQ_STATUS.alert.
If sample_done is set, service the completed sample and write IRQ_CLEAR bit 1 to clear STATUS.sample_done and IRQ_STATUS.sample_done.
If desired, write CONTROL.ALERT_CLEAR to clear alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending without affecting sample count or latest temperature.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
No new hierarchy or external bus protocol is introduced beyond the specified custom register interface.
Register offsets and field semantics match the supplied specification.
Reserved bits read as 0 and ignore writes unless defined as write-one-to-clear bits.
sample_req is a one-cycle pulse and may also be generated periodically only when CONTROL.ENABLE is set.
